license: Original code and fixtures authored for this evaluation. No upstream source file is copied into this package. The behaviour contract comes from the documented Windows process-creation model: a child created with handle inheritance enabled receives every handle that carries the inherit flag, and the only way to narrow that set is PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST together with STARTUPINFOEX (MSDN: UpdateProcThreadAttribute, PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST).
lineage: Documented Windows process-creation semantics (default inheritance of every inheritable handle; narrowing requires an attribute list on an extended STARTUPINFO) -> workspace module wspawn frozen in the naive shape that merely passes close_fds=False -> Windows handle-handover contract expressed as acceptance criteria A-G -> evaluator-side independent measurement: the grader creates its own pipes, sets the inherit bit, spawns a child through the candidate and asks the child which handles it can actually use -> local oracle/no-change differential calibration -> container control runs on the pinned Windows Server Core image.
pollution_risk: Low. The subject is Windows child-process handle inheritance driven through STARTUPINFOEX and PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST plus SetHandleInformation/GetHandleInformation and GetFileType. A dedup sweep over all 158 records of the procurement Base for the keywords RegNotifyChangeKeyValue, bInheritHandles, PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE, HANDLE_LIST, 句柄继承, 可继承句柄, CancelIoEx, MAX_PATH, SeCreateSymbolicLink and 作业对象 returned no hit for the handle-inheritance family; the neighbouring families that are occupied are file identity and hard links (win-fileid-017 plus six more), Job Objects (win-job-005), reserved device names (win-safe-materialization) and the registry batch tasks. Python's own subprocess module cannot express a handle list at all, so a relabelled duplicate of an existing task is not possible.
authorization: No external repository is vendored. The only third-party artefacts are the pinned Microsoft Windows Server Core base image, the PSF-licensed Python 3.12.9 embeddable distribution, MinGit and the offline wheelhouse already used by the other tasks in this batch. No network access is required to build or grade the task.
